remarks: Welcome to this brand-new 2,510 sq. ft. two-storey home offering exceptional design, functionality, and modern finishes. The main floor features a versatile den or potential in-law bedroom, complete with its own private 4-piece bath. A functional rear mudroom connects to a walk-through butler’s pantry leading into the gourmet kitchen showcasing a large 7’ island, full dinette wall cabinetry, and plenty of workspace. The kitchen opens to an impressive Great Room featuring soaring 17’ open-to-above ceilings and a modern electric fireplace feature wall. Upstairs, the spacious primary retreat offers a luxurious 5-piece ensuite and a walk-through closet with direct access to the upper laundry room. Two additional bedrooms, a full bathroom, and a generous bonus room complete the upper level. The oversized double attached garage provides ample space for vehicles and storage. Still time to personalize and choose your own colors and finishes! Visit the Show Home at 558 Meadowview Dr., Fort Saskatchewan. (id:67522)
